_comment: Astro-Databank record for every bundled figure (birth date, recorded local time, time standard, Rodden rating), used by FigureLibraryTests to check Lore's data. expectedUtc is the instant Astro-Databank's stated time standard implies. Checked October 2026.

albert-camus.note: Astro-Databank's latitude for Mondovi (Dréan) is a degree off; Lore keeps the correct coordinates (GMT, so the instant is unaffected).

claude-bernard.note: Astro-Databank's coordinates are for Saint-Julien (Jura); the birthplace is Saint-Julien (Rhône), so LMT uses Lore's longitude.
